verdict.rationale: Lemon Squeezy is a merchant-of-record payments and checkout platform, not an AI agent or assistant. Consuming MCP servers as a client is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows any built-in agent or AI feature that could act as an MCP client, so the exception that would make this axis applicable does not arise.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
